rows.Bloom: Salmon-pink. Salmon pink. Full (26-40 petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, globular bloom form. Prolific, blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy, spreading. Semi-glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: up to 30" (up to 75cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Disease susceptibility: disease resistant.
